c74object.name: mc.ear.direct~
c74object.category: spatial audio, ADM, panning, audio, mc
c74object.digest: Render ADM DirectSpeakers channels (a channel bed) to loudspeaker signals with libear (ITU-R BS.2127), with multichannel signal input and output
c74object.description: Render ADM DirectSpeakers channels (a channel bed) to loudspeaker signals with libear (ITU-R BS.2127), with multichannel signal input and output. Every input channel is a DirectSpeakers channel identified by speaker label or position; the output has one channel per loudspeaker of the BS.2051 layout given as argument. 'inputlayout NAME' labels the input channels after a BS.2051 layout, for example to render a 0+5+0 bed.

method.name: align
method.description: Set the align attribute. Delay the output by the latency of the object renderers (255 samples, the BS.2127 decorrelator compensation delay) so that a bed stays time-aligned with mc.ear.objects~ and ear.objects~ when their decorrelation is on, as the EAR reference renderer does. Turn off for zero latency when no decorrelating renderer is mixed in.

method.name: anything
method.digest: Any channel parameter sent as a message, such as 'packformat AP_00010003' or 'lfe 0', is applied to all input channels
method.description: Any channel parameter sent as a message, such as 'packformat AP_00010003' or 'lfe 0', is applied to all input channels.

method.name: applyvalues
method.digest: Spread values over the input channels: 'applyvalues speakerlabel M+030 M-030 M+000' labels channels 1, 2 and 3
method.description: Spread values over the input channels: 'applyvalues speakerlabel M+030 M-030 M+000' labels channels 1, 2 and 3.

method.name: channels
method.digest: Post the channel names of the output layout to the Max console
method.description: Post the channel names of the output layout to the Max console.

method.name: chans
method.description: Set the chans attribute. Number of input channels allocated. It grows by itself when the input signal carries more channels, or a setvalue, applyvalues or inputlayout addresses a higher one, up to 1024; new channels take effect when the audio is restarted.

method.name: inputlayout
method.digest: Label the input channels after a BS.2051 layout: 'inputlayout 0+5+0' gives channels 1..6 the speaker labels M+030 M-030 M+000 LFE1 M+110 M-110 (LFE channels are marked as LFE)
method.description: Label the input channels after a BS.2051 layout: 'inputlayout 0+5+0' gives channels 1..6 the speaker labels M+030 M-030 M+000 LFE1 M+110 M-110 (LFE channels are marked as LFE). Channels beyond the layout are cleared.

method.name: layout
method.description: Set the layout attribute. ITU-R BS.2051 output layout name, fixed at creation (give it as argument).

method.name: ramp
method.description: Set the ramp attribute. Gain interpolation time in milliseconds when metadata changes.

method.name: setvalue
method.digest: Set a parameter of one input channel: 'setvalue N parameter values...' (N is 1-based; 0 sets all)
method.description: Set a parameter of one input channel: 'setvalue N parameter values...' (N is 1-based; 0 sets all). Parameters: speakerlabel cartesian position azimuth elevation distance x y z bounds lfe packformat (with cartesian on, position is x y z and bounds XMin XMax YMin YMax ZMin ZMax, as Dolby Atmos masters give their beds).

attribute.name: align
attribute.digest: Delay the output by the latency of the object renderers (255 samples, the BS.2127 decorrelator compensation delay) so that a bed stays time-aligned with mc.ear.objects~ and ear.objects~ when their decorrelation is on, as the EAR reference renderer does
attribute.description: Delay the output by the latency of the object renderers (255 samples, the BS.2127 decorrelator compensation delay) so that a bed stays time-aligned with mc.ear.objects~ and ear.objects~ when their decorrelation is on, as the EAR reference renderer does. Turn off for zero latency when no decorrelating renderer is mixed in. Default: 1.

attribute.name: chans
attribute.description: Number of input channels allocated. It grows by itself when the input signal carries more channels, or a setvalue, applyvalues or inputlayout addresses a higher one, up to 1024; new channels take effect when the audio is restarted. Default: 16.

attribute.name: layout
attribute.digest: ITU-R BS.2051 output layout name, fixed at creation (give it as argument)
attribute.description: ITU-R BS.2051 output layout name, fixed at creation (give it as argument).

attribute.name: ramp
attribute.digest: Gain interpolation time in milliseconds when metadata changes
attribute.description: Gain interpolation time in milliseconds when metadata changes. Default: 10.
